title: Bride and Groom Floral
author: litcyz
description:
Romantic Dancing Bride and Groom Floral Embroidery Design 🧵💃🕺
Capture the magic of the first dance with this exquisite dancing bride and groom machine embroidery design! 💍🌹✨
Featuring a graceful line-art silhouette of a newlywed couple dancing, highlighted by a breathtaking gown that flows into an intricate cascade of dusty pink and red roses, leaf tendrils, and delicate swashes. This artistic bridal design brings an enchanting, boutique aesthetic to wedding keepsakes, custom ring bearer pillows, bridal jackets, anniversary gifts, linen handkerchiefs, or framed wall decor.
Celebrate love and life's most memorable moments in stitched elegance today! 🥂💖
